jordan_support: Heads up — customer reporting auth failures + intermittent 502s. Need a sanitized repro and a scrubbed debug bundle we can ingest. Request IDs: req_20240401_abc123, req_20240401_def456. Can eng take repro + ops handle redaction? :wave:

alex_irwin: I'll pick up repro. Can you drop the exact request_id(s), timestamps, and a minimal sanitized prompt sample here? Also which model/region they hit?

jordan_support: request_ids: req_20240401_abc123, req_20240401_def456. timestamps: 2024-04-01T15:22:03Z, 2024-04-01T15:23:10Z. model: text-redwood-1 (us-west-2). Customer prompt (sanitized): "Summarize order for [CUSTOMER_ORDER_ID] for user [USER_EMAIL_TOKEN]." Header snippet: X-Request-Id: req_20240401_abc123, Authorization: Bearer <redacted>. I'll attach raw logs to the ticket (private).

maria_ops: For debug bundle collection, please use the internal collector with anonymize flag and produce a mapping file. Steps we expect from support before upload:
1) Run (on internal machine or ask us to run):
```
./collect-debug-bundle --request req_20240401_abc123 --anonymize --out /tmp/db-abc123.tar.gz
```
2) The collector will produce a mapping file at /tmp/db-abc123.mapping.txt. That mapping should list only replaced-PII -> token hashes (no raw PII in the bundle).
3) Mask emails/names in any pasted prompt or logs to [EMAIL_REDACTED]/[NAME_REDACTED]. Keep request_id and timestamps unchanged.
If you can't run collector, paste a minimal curl and we'll run it in staging.

kevin_eng: To reproduce, paste a sanitized curl (no real auth) and I'll run it in staging. Example sanitized curl we ask customers to provide: 
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'X-Request-Id: req_20240401_abc123' \
  -d '{"model":"text-redwood-1","input":"Summarize order for [ORDER_ID]"}'
```
Note: remove attachments, and replace any names/emails with tokens. Having the X-Request-Id header is very helpful.

jordan_support: Pasted minimal prompt above and included quick customer snippet: had an email user@example.com in one line — please replace with [EMAIL_HASH:1] before upload. I will not put raw PII into ticket.

maria_ops: Quick sed to mask emails in logs before attaching (run locally):
```
sed -E "s/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[EMAIL_REDACTED]/g" original.log > scrubbed.log
```
If you need deterministic mapping (to correlate across bundles) generate short hashes and store only the mapping in the secure ticket: 
```
python -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(sys.argv[1].encode()).hexdigest()[:8])" user@example.com
```
Put mapping lines like: `user@example.com -> EMAIL_HASH_1` in mapping.txt and ONLY attach the hashed side in the bundle. Legal requires raw->hash mapping to stay in ticket metadata.

maria_ops: Also, please remove Authorization header from any public paste and replace token with REDACTED. We only need the header name presence or X-Request-Id for routing.

sre-bot: trace collected: trace-20240401-abc123 (stack idx 4). Auto-cc @kevin_eng.

kevin_eng: I'll attempt the sanitized repro in staging. If it fails, request the scrubbed debug bundle upload to secure ticket storage (use the collector command above).

legal-emma: Quick compliance note: the mapping file that ties hashed identifiers back to raw PII must be stored in the secure ticket only (access-limited). For cross-team debugging we accept hashed values + the hashing method used. Please confirm customer consent if debug bundle includes any customer-owned PII.

jordan_support: Understood — will upload scrubbed bundle and mapping to the secure ticket and confirm consent note. I'll ping here when done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
